package bytesrepresentation_test

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	service "example.com/bytesrepresentation/gen/byte_representations"
	client "example.com/bytesrepresentation/gen/http/byte_representations/client"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

func TestNamedBytesResponseValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, body, value, code, detail string
		valid                           bool
	}{
		{"valid_hi", `"aGk="`, "hi", "", "", true},
		{"valid_bye", `"Ynll"`, "bye", "", "", true},
		{"empty", `""`, "", "", "length of body must be greater or equal than 1", false},
		{"overlong", `"bG9uZw=="`, "", "", "length of body must be lesser or equal than 3", false},
		{"not_enum_member", `"bm8="`, "", loom.InvalidEnumValue, "invalid value for \"body\"", false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			hs := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, tc.body); err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
				}
			}))
			defer hs.Close()

			transport := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(hs.URL, "http://"), hs.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			got, err := transport.StaticJSON()(t.Context(), nil)
			if tc.valid {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				body, ok := got.(service.RepresentationBlob)
				if !ok || string(body) != tc.value {
					t.Errorf("decoded response=%T(%v), want %q", got, got, tc.value)
				}
				return
			}
			var clientErr *loomhttp.ClientError
			if !errors.As(err, &clientErr) || clientErr.Name != "validation_error" {
				t.Fatalf("error=%v, want validation_error", err)
			}
			if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.detail) {
				t.Errorf("error=%v, want detail %q", err, tc.detail)
			}
			if tc.code != "" {
				var serviceErr *loom.ServiceError
				if !errors.As(err, &serviceErr) || serviceErr.Name != tc.code {
					t.Errorf("error=%v, want nested %s", err, tc.code)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
